entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker and Futurist who hunts the man with the metal arm to bring the emperor home, and steals the Reality Chip.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A moonfolk planeswalker and gatherer of knowledge who is Nashi's mother and tells Kaito about Tezzeret and the Wanderer.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A young nezumi tinkerer, Tamiyo's son, who survived the burning of his village.

entities.name: Tezzeret
aliases: the planeswalker with the metal arm
the man with the metal arm
entities.description: A planeswalker with a metal arm who ordered the attack on Nashi's village, tried to control Kyodai with a Reality Chip prototype, and is researching kami.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker, who is the emperor of Kamigawa, whose spark was set off by Tezzeret's Reality Chip; she appears with a sword and saves Kaito.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A chrome Phyrexian monster who leads the lab operation and murdered Tameshi, and sends ninjas after Kaito.

entities.name: Tameshi
entities.description: Kaito's late friend, whose lab key card Kaito uses.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: The tanuki kami in drone and mask form who follows the nezumi's drone for Kaito.

entities.name: Mud-Tail
entities.description: An older gray nezumi in the swamp village who refuses to help Kaito and secretly sends a message to Tamiyo.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: Kaito's former teacher whom he imagines would be proud of his focus.

entities.name: Eiko Shizuki
entities.description: Kaito's sister.

entities.name: Rumiyo
entities.description: A companion Tamiyo tells Nashi to take to the market.

entities.name: Hiroku
entities.description: A companion Tamiyo tells Nashi to take to the market.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The guardian kami that Tezzeret tried to control with the Reality Chip.

entities.name: Nezumi
entities.description: The rat-folk of the swamp who hide Nashi and distrust humans.

entities.name: Nezumi-Katsuro gang
entities.description: The gang inhabiting the nezumi village that was burned five years earlier.

entities.name: Okiba Reckoners
entities.description: A biker gang made up exclusively of nezumi that trades with swamp nezumi.

entities.name: Undercity ninjas
entities.description: Hired Undercity ninjas who fight for Jin-Gitaxias.

entities.name: Reality Chip
entities.description: A thin square chip with wires that Tezzeret prototyped as a weapon; it set off the Wanderer's spark and later stirs in Kaito's pocket.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: The floating city of Futurists where Tamiyo lives and Tezzeret's lab stands.

entities.name: Nezumi swamp
entities.description: A poisonous bog home to the nezumi villages.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Tamiyo met the Wanderer.

entities.name: Kami of the Wetland
entities.description: A swamp kami that carries a message to the nezumi.

events.summary: Following weeks of searching for Tezzeret, Kaito travels into the nezumi swamp to find the child Nashi.
events.quote: But the key to finding Tezzeret was with the nezumi.

events.summary: A Living Historian's account reveals a nezumi village was burned five years earlier on Tezzeret's order, and the child Nashi survived.
events.quote: Nashi listened to the adults whisper the name of the man who ordered the attack.

events.summary: The nezumi elder Mud-Tail refuses to talk to Kaito about Nashi.
Kaito sends Himoto to eavesdrop and learns a kami has carried word of Otawara to a nezumi who will warn someone there.
Kaito follows the nezumi's rabbit drone to Otawara.
events.quote: The tanuki followed, and Kaito headed in the direction of Otawara.

events.summary: Kaito fights a moonfolk with scrolls, who paralyzes him with a scroll spell.
events.quote: The moment she read the words, Kaito felt his entire body stiffen.

events.summary: Learning that Kaito knows of Tezzeret, the moonfolk releases the spell and introduces herself as Tamiyo.
events.quote: "I am Tamiyo," she said, voice as unwavering as steel.

events.summary: Kaito realizes Tamiyo is a planeswalker, and meets her son Nashi.
Tamiyo tells Kaito that Tezzeret is the man with the metal arm and that he burned the nezumi village.
events.quote: Kaito learned that Tezzeret wasn't just a planeswalker—he was the planeswalker with the metal arm.

events.summary: Tamiyo reveals the Reality Chip and that the Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same.
events.quote: "The Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same."

events.summary: Kaito resolves to steal the chip immediately rather than wait as Tamiyo urges.
events.quote: And he wasn't about to wait for Tamiyo's permission.

events.summary: Kaito uses Tameshi's key card to enter the lab and finds kami being drained of their essence.
events.quote: There were dozens of them—alive, but shriveled and dull, as if their very essence was being sucked out of them.

events.summary: Kaito steals the Reality Chip from its stand.
events.quote: So Kaito reached out, grabbed the Reality Chip from its stand, and shoved it in his pocket.

events.summary: Kaito encounters the monster who murdered Tameshi, who names himself Jin-Gitaxias and calls ninjas.
events.quote: The existence of a second Jin-Gitaxias on this plane is highly improbable

events.summary: Kaito fights the Undercity ninjas and escapes the lab with a smoke bomb.
events.quote: Black smoke exploded through the crowd

events.summary: Cornered by a dragon-shaped mech, Kaito chooses not to planeswalk with the chip.
events.quote: Leaving right now was too great a risk.

events.summary: The Reality Chip stirs, and a swordswoman cuts down the mech: the emperor, who is the Wanderer.
Tamiyo hides the henchmen with an invisibility spell, and the three planeswalkers flee Otawara.
events.quote: the three planeswalkers fled from Otawara in silence.

relations.quote: "I believe you know of my son, Nashi."
She told me about Tezzeret and the weapon he was prototyping.

relations.note: Kaito identifies him as the monster who murdered Tameshi
the nezumi hid the child from Tezzeret's organization
relations.quote: the nezumi did the only thing they could—they helped the child become a ghost.

relations.note: they agree to work together to find Tezzeret
relations.quote: And perhaps you and I are meant to be allies."

relations.note: Tezzeret retaliated when they refused to sell their land and burned the village
relations.quote: But when the nezumi refused to sell their land, Tezzeret retaliated.

relations.note: hired henchmen who appear at his sides
relations.quote: Half a dozen armed ninjas appeared at the monster's sides.
